root_cause: The canonical publisher chose first action verb 'bereid' from the approved 'Hoe bereid je je MKB-boekhouding ...' title as its focus keyword, then fallback seo_title omitted the actual subject and wrote lowercase, generic 'bereid: wat verandert er voor jou?' into the exact article, blog index and RSS. Protected SEO preflight caught it.
prevention: Use source-backed subject extraction that excludes generic opening verbs and preserves hyphenated noun phrases. Generate a concise content-specific headline only from approved subject/target; keep existing legacy title policy unchanged. Run source exact regression before protected blog PR / NL+EN publishing. Preserve original writer and single same-date obligation; keep all i18n, security, protected CI, Netlify and independent production receipt gates.
